summary: Verified new admin invoice endpoint and Invoice button on AllJobsModal. 9/9 backend tests pass (auth 401, 404, HTML branding, cu ft math, per-item cost proportional-sum-to-base, approved_price override, extras rows, grand total, PAID badge on/off). Frontend confirms Invoice button (data-testid=invoice-btn-{id}) present on ALL 77 job cards (paid + cancelled + scheduled), sits alongside Email Customer and Edit buttons, and click triggers window.open with correct /api/admin/bookings/{id}/invoice URL. Rendered invoice visually verified: T2T lime/black branding, itemized table with QTY/SIZE/VOLUME/COST columns, per-item cuft, service subtotal + grand total in T2T lime.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider HTML-escaping quote item name/description before f-string interpolation (server.py:3208-3209). Line items come from user-generated quotes; unescaped '<' or quotes could break rendering or enable stored-XSS if any admin views the invoice. Use html.escape() on name/description/size fields.
seed_data_creation: 6 ephemeral quote+booking pairs tagged TEST_ITER22, all deleted by fixture teardown. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice endpoint is at GET /api/admin/bookings/{id}/invoice, protected by admin_session cookie middleware. VOLUME_BY_SIZE: small=8, medium=25, large=60. Per-item cost = base_price * (item_cuft / total_cuft). Extras rows only render when > 0. .paid-badge CSS class is always present in <style>; check for `class="paid-badge"` in body when asserting badge visibility. Frontend Invoice button uses data-testid=invoice-btn-{job.id} and appears on every AllJobsModal card regardless of status.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no issues found. Only minor XSS-hardening suggestion noted in code review.
